title: ajax luteus var. major
intro: Ajax luteus var. major, commonly known as Ajuga reptans, is a perennial plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is a flowering plant native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and relieving respiratory issues, thanks to its health benefits such as antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory actions. The bioactive constituents of Ajuga reptans include iridoids (such as aucubin and ajugol), phenolic acids (like chlorogenic acid), and volatile oils, which contribute to its therapeutic actions.
